description: Models the MJML <mj-attributes> head section: global defaults (mj-all), per-component defaults and named classes (mj-class). The importer keeps this cascade intact rather than flattening it onto blocks, preserving both fidelity and editability of global styles.

members.name: Resolve
members.description: Resolves the head-level value of an attribute for a component, following MJML precedence: referenced classes (later class wins) > per-tag default > mj-all. Returns when no head rule supplies the attribute (the block's own value or the MJML built-in default then applies). The block's own inline value is not considered here.

members.name: All
members.description: Gets the attributes applied to every component (mj-all).

members.name: Classes
members.description: Gets the named class definitions (mj-class), keyed by class name.

members.name: PerTag
members.description: Gets the per-component default attributes, keyed by MJML tag name (e.g. mj-text).
